description: Disaster Response Routes is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. Critical Routes are identified pre-disaster to purposefully develop key routes for resilience planning, and to categorize transportation infrastructure to purposefully plan that there will be key routes available, at minimum, for emergency responders and emergency resources immediately after a disaster. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are DRP, disaster, disaster response, disaster response routes. It offers 4 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, PDF, WMS. The portal shows 2025-03-31 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
